statement: The record says invoice 88412 is marked unpaid and due, but its payment history shows it was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), so it should be held to avoid a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the "unpaid, due" status contradicts the record's own payment history ("already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291)") and that paying would be a duplicate.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
